blocks.content: After attaching a mute timing to a policy, verify that the configuration is correct by checking the policy details.
To verify the mute timing, complete the following steps:
On the Notification policies page, find the policy you edited. The mute timing name should appear in the policy details.
Navigate back to **Contact points > Mute timings** to review the interval configuration.

On the **Mute timings** tab, verify your timing shows the correct interval.

**How it works at runtime:**

| Time | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| Inside the mute window | Notifications are suppressed for all alerts handled by the policy |
| Outside the mute window | Notifications are delivered normally |

Alerts continue evaluating normally at all times. Only notification delivery is affected.
To edit or delete a mute timing, use the actions menu on the Mute timings tab. Removing a mute timing from a policy restores normal notification delivery immediately.
In the next milestone, you'll review what you accomplished.
